text:
melissa_cs: Heads up — Calypso's renewal is coming due in 11 days. They want to shorten from 12→9 months to match their fiscal window and asked if we can prorate and take a one-time discount. Quote lives here: https://redwood-sales/quotes/CL-983
juan_ae: Quick Q — is the customer requesting the shorter term because of budget only, or are they asking to change billing cadence too?
matt_finance: Need numbers before we commit to a discount. What's the ARR and proposed invoice amount for 9mo?
sarah_legal: If it's a pure term/price amendment with no custom clauses, we can use our standard amendment template and push via Adobe Sign. If they want new legal language we escalate.
melissa_cs: ARR is $72k/yr. 9mo base would be $54k; customer proposed $48,600 (~10% off). They say procurement will send a PO and want an Adobe Sign link for signature.
juan_ae: Got it — I'll mark the CRM with the proposed 10% override but won't finalize until legal+finance sign off.
matt_finance: 10% is borderline but might be OK for retention. We need the PO with vendor code and the invoice entity. Also confirm payment terms; if they want Net60 that's a hard no.
sarah_legal: I can draft the amendment tomorrow AM. If no custom terms, it should be one page. Please flag any requested legal changes.
ops_bot: AdobeSign task created: AS-2026-88. Waiting on finance approval and vendor_code to attach invoice details.
melissa_cs: Action list: (1) Juan confirm discount in CRM (2) Matt collect vendor_code + confirm payment terms (3) Sarah draft amendment (4) I collect PO and send Adobe Sign.
juan_ae: Updating CRM now and pinging the AE who owns the account for final confirmation.
matt_finance: Reached out to procurement@calypso.io for vendor code and payment terms. ETA EOD tomorrow.
sarah_legal: I'll post draft to this thread when ready for quick review. If anyone sees red flags call them out ASAP.
melissa_cs: Excellent. Once vendor code + Sarah's draft are in, I'll attach to AdobeSign and send. Will also confirm whether billing entity should be "Redwood Inference, Inc." or the EMEA subsidiary.
juan_ae: Customer also asked if we can accept ACH. Any blockers?
matt_finance: ACH is fine. Net30 / ACH acceptable. Net60 not ok without credit escalation.
melissa_cs: Thanks team — please update here as items come in. :thumbsup:
